prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent 2D game prop spritesheet used above a small character's hands during kitchen food preparation
Primary request: draw one complete small kitchen-prep board prop in eight camera directions. The board holds a few fresh sliced vegetables and a small piece of bread. This is a prop-only atlas, with no character parts.
Scene/backdrop: fully transparent outside the prop.
Subject: a compact light wood cutting board with a tomato slice, cucumber pieces, leafy greens, and one small bread slice. The prop must read clearly when drawn around 28 game pixels high.
Style/medium: polished hand-painted 2D game sprite with a clean dark outline, soft texture shading and the warm detailed food-art style used by a cozy life-sim.
Composition/framing: one 4-column by 2-row atlas, 1536 by 1024 overall with eight 384 by 512 transparent cells. Row 1 is southeast, south, southwest, west. Row 2 is northwest, north, northeast, east. Draw the same compact prop independently in each correct perspective, centered with generous transparent gutters.
Lighting/mood: consistent soft studio game lighting and one shared light direction.
Color palette: natural tomato red, cucumber green, leafy green and warm pale bread on a light wood board.
Materials/textures: subtle wood grain, fresh vegetable surfaces, soft bread texture.
Constraints: genuinely transparent alpha outside every item; each of the eight perspectives must be distinct and correctly oriented; identical object size, visual center and scale in every cell; keep all pixels inside the cell.
Avoid: background, floor shadow, gradient, checkerboard, text, label, watermark, person, hands, arms, gloves, utensils, plates, bowl, extra boards, duplicate poses, cropped objects, cell borders.
